question: When will my order arrive?
answer: Orders arrive in 3-5 business days. You get a tracking link by email.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: Credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking and cash on delivery.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Start a return from My Orders within 7 days of delivery.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: Yes, until the order is shipped - edit it in My Orders.

question: How can I track my package?
answer: Use the tracking link in your shipping email, or open My Orders.

question: Do you deliver on weekends?
answer: We deliver on Saturdays in most cities; there is no Sunday delivery.

question: Is express delivery available?
answer: Express delivery in 1-2 days is available in metro cities for a small fee.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: No, we currently deliver only within India.

question: What are the delivery charges?
answer: Delivery is free on orders above Rs 499; below that it costs Rs 40.

question: My package shows delivered but I did not receive it
answer: Check with neighbours and building security, then report it in My Orders within 48 hours.

question: Is cash on delivery (COD) available?
answer: COD is available on orders up to Rs 10000 in most pin codes.

question: Can I pay in EMIs?
answer: No-cost EMI is available on credit cards for orders above Rs 3000.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted
answer: Failed payments are refunded automatically to the source within 5-7 business days.

question: Is it safe to save my card?
answer: Cards are saved as secure tokens; we never store the full card number.

question: Can I get a GST invoice?
answer: Add your GSTIN at checkout and download the GST invoice from My Orders.

question: Why was my card declined?
answer: Check the card limit and the OTP, or try another payment method.

question: Do you accept gift cards?
answer: Yes, enter the gift card code on the payment page.

question: Can I split a payment across two methods?
answer: You can combine a gift card or wallet balance with one other payment method.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds reach your original payment method 5-7 business days after the pickup.

question: Can I exchange for a different size?
answer: Choose Exchange instead of Return in My Orders; one exchange per item is free.

question: Which items cannot be returned?
answer: Innerwear, personal care items and opened software cannot be returned.

question: I received a damaged product
answer: Report it within 48 hours with photos and we send a free replacement.

question: I received the wrong item
answer: Report it in My Orders; we collect it and send the right item free of charge.

question: Do I pay for return shipping?
answer: No, pickup for returns is always free.

question: How is a COD refund paid?
answer: COD refunds go to your bank account by NEFT or to your store wallet.

question: Can I return an item I bought on sale?
answer: Yes, sale items follow the same 7-day return window.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Cancel from My Orders before it ships and you get a full refund.

question: Can I add items to an order I already placed?
answer: No, place a new order instead; orders above Rs 499 still ship free.

question: Why was my order cancelled?
answer: Orders are cancelled if the payment fails or the item goes out of stock; any payment is refunded.

question: Can I order without creating an account?
answer: Yes, use guest checkout with your phone number.

question: How do I place a bulk order?
answer: Use the Bulk Orders form on the Help page and we call you back within a day.

question: When will an out-of-stock item be back?
answer: Tap Notify Me on the product page and we email you when it is back.

question: Can I choose a delivery date?
answer: Large appliances let you pick a delivery slot at checkout.

question: How do I know my order is confirmed?
answer: You get a confirmation SMS and email within minutes of paying.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Tap Forgot Password on the login page and follow the link we email you.

question: I am not receiving the OTP
answer: Check your phone number, wait 60 seconds and tap Resend OTP.

question: How do I change my phone number?
answer: Go to Account > Profile and verify the new number with an OTP.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Raise a request under Account > Privacy; deletion completes within 30 days.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: Chat with us 24/7 from the Help page, or call our toll-free number.

question: How do I stop promotional emails?
answer: Use the Unsubscribe link in any email, or switch them off in Account > Notifications.

question: Do products come with a warranty?
answer: Electronics carry the manufacturer's warranty, usually one year.

question: How do I claim a warranty?
answer: Contact the brand's service centre with the invoice from My Orders.

question: Can I buy an extended warranty?
answer: Yes, add an extended warranty at checkout for eligible electronics.

question: Are your products genuine?
answer: All products come directly from brands or their authorised sellers.

question: How do I apply a coupon code?
answer: Enter the coupon on the payment page before you pay.

question: Why is my coupon not working?
answer: Check the minimum order value, the expiry date and the eligible categories.

question: Do you match prices from other shops?
answer: No, but the Offers page lists current bank and card discounts.

question: How does the loyalty programme work?
answer: Earn 1 point for every Rs 100 you spend; 100 points give Rs 50 off.
